parts.text: I plan and run our flights as a dispatcher, which makes me the licensed person responsible for each flight. My duties include deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves and can call it off. When planning, I might have several dispatchers working at the same time for the same busy sites and popular drones, and while software never chooses a drone or way for us, I do want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts. People and devices outside my company report things like whether a load is ready or if the drone reaches its job points and arrives.
